      "source": [
        "#@title Import Libraries\n",
        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "from scipy.stats import mode\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold\n",
        "from sklearn.svm import SVC\n",
        "from sklearn.naive_bayes import GaussianNB\n",
        "from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix\n",
        "from imblearn.over_sampling import RandomOverSampler\n",
        "%matplotlib inline\n",
        "\n"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#@title Loading dataset\n",
        "\n",
        "data = pd.read_csv('/content/drive/MyDrive/improved_disease_dataset.csv')\n",
        "\n",
        "encoder = LabelEncoder()\n",
        "data[\"disease\"] = encoder.fit_transform(data[\"disease\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "X = data.iloc[:, :-1]\n",
        "y = data.iloc[:, -1]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(18, 8))\n",
        "sns.countplot(x=y)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Disease Class Distribution Before Resampling\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=90)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "ros = RandomOverSampler(random_state=42)\n",
        "X_resampled, y_resampled = ros.fit_resample(X, y)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 419
        },
        "id": "QO67pyVkXqFy",
        "outputId": "bb50cbea-bcd0-4199-801e-6e5210b604eb"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1800x800 with 1 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#@title Using Stratified K-fold Cross-Validation on 3 ML Models\n",
        "\n",
        "# Label encode 'gender' column if it exists\n",
        "if 'gender' in X_resampled.columns:\n",
        "    le = LabelEncoder()\n",
        "    X_resampled['gender'] = le.fit_transform(X_resampled['gender'])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Fill any remaining NaN values with 0\n",
        "X_resampled = X_resampled.fillna(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Flatten y_resampled if it's not already a 1D array\n",
        "if len(y_resampled.shape) > 1:\n",
        "    y_resampled = y_resampled.values.ravel()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Define the models to evaluate\n",
        "models = {\n",
        "    \"Decision Tree\": DecisionTreeClassifier(),\n",
        "    \"Random Forest\": RandomForestClassifier(),\n",
        "    \"SVM\": SVC()\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "# Set the scoring metric and Stratified K-fold parameters\n",
        "cv_scoring = 'accuracy'  # you can also use 'f1_weighted', 'roc_auc_ovr' for multi-class\n",
        "stratified_kfold = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Evaluate each model using cross-validation\n",
        "for model_name, model in models.items():\n",
        "    try:\n",
        "        scores = cross_val_score(\n",
        "            model,\n",
        "            X_resampled,\n",
        "            y_resampled,\n",
        "            cv=stratified_kfold,\n",
        "            scoring=cv_scoring,\n",
        "            n_jobs=-1,\n",
        "            error_score='raise'\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        print(\"=\" * 50)\n",
        "        print(f\"Model: {model_name}\")\n",
        "        print(f\"Scores: {scores}\")\n",
        "        print(f\"Mean Accuracy: {scores.mean():.4f}\")\n",
        "    except Exception as e:\n",
        "        print(\"=\" * 50)\n",
        "        print(f\"Model: {model_name} failed with error:\")\n",
        "        print(e)"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#@title Support Vector Classifier\n",
        "\n",
        "svm_model = SVC()\n",
        "svm_model.fit(X_resampled, y_resampled)\n",
        "svm_preds = svm_model.predict(X_resampled)\n",
        "\n",
        "cf_matrix_svm = confusion_matrix(y_resampled, svm_preds)\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(cf_matrix_svm, annot=True, fmt=\"d\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Confusion Matrix for SVM Classifier\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"SVM Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_resampled, svm_preds) * 100:.2f}%\")"
      ],

      "source": [
        "#@title Combining all 4 Models for prediction\n",
        "\n",
        "from statistics import mode\n",
        "\n",
        "final_preds = [mode([i, j, k, l]) for i, j, k, l in zip(svm_preds, nb_preds, rf_preds, dt_preds)]\n",
        "\n",
        "cf_matrix_combined = confusion_matrix(y_resampled, final_preds)\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(cf_matrix_combined, annot=True, fmt=\"d\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Confusion Matrix for Combined Model\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Combined Model Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_resampled, final_preds) * 100:.2f}%\")"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#@title Creating Predictions Function\n",
        "\n",
        "symptoms = X.columns.values\n",
        "symptom_index = {symptom: idx for idx, symptom in enumerate(symptoms)}\n",
        "\n",
        "def predict_disease(input_symptoms):\n",
        "    input_symptoms = input_symptoms.split(\",\")\n",
        "    input_data = [0] * len(symptom_index)\n",
        "\n",
        "    for symptom in input_symptoms:\n",
        "        if symptom in symptom_index:\n",
        "            input_data[symptom_index[symptom]] = 1\n",
        "\n",
        "    input_df = pd.DataFrame([input_data], columns=symptoms)\n",
        "\n",
        "    rf_pred = encoder.classes_[rf_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "    nb_pred = encoder.classes_[nb_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "    svm_pred = encoder.classes_[svm_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "    dt_pred = encoder.classes_[dt_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "\n",
        "    final_pred = mode([rf_pred, nb_pred, svm_pred, dt_pred])\n",
        "\n",
        "    return {\n",
        "        \"Random Forest Prediction\": rf_pred,\n",
        "        \"Naive Bayes Prediction\": nb_pred,\n",
        "        \"SVM Prediction\": svm_pred,\n",
        "        \"Decision Tree Prediction\": dt_pred,\n",
        "        \"Final Prediction\": final_pred\n",
        "    }\n",
        "\n",
        "print(predict_disease(\"fever,cough,headache,vomiting, fatigue\"))"
      ],
      "metadata": {

        "#@title The User interface\n",
        "\n",
        "!pip install gradio\n",
        "import gradio as gr\n",
        "from statistics import mode\n",
        "\n",
        "# === Ensure your predict_disease() function is defined above ===\n",
        "\n",
        "def predict_disease_gradio(symptom_text):\n",
        "    input_symptoms = symptom_text.split(\",\")\n",
        "    input_data = [0] * len(symptom_index)\n",
        "\n",
        "    for symptom in input_symptoms:\n",
        "        symptom = symptom.strip()\n",
        "        if symptom in symptom_index:\n",
        "            input_data[symptom_index[symptom]] = 1\n",
        "\n",
        "    input_df = pd.DataFrame([input_data], columns=symptoms)\n",
        "\n",
        "    rf_pred = encoder.classes_[rf_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "    nb_pred = encoder.classes_[nb_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "    svm_pred = encoder.classes_[svm_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "    dt_pred = encoder.classes_[dt_model.predict(input_df)[0]]\n",
        "\n",
        "    final_pred = mode([rf_pred, nb_pred, svm_pred, dt_pred])\n",
        "    return f\"🩺 Final Prediction: {final_pred}\"\n",
        "\n",
        "# === Gradio Interface ===\n",
        "iface = gr.Interface(\n",
        "    fn=predict_disease_gradio,\n",
        "    inputs=gr.Textbox(\n",
        "        label=\"Enter Symptoms\",\n",
        "        placeholder=\"e.g., fever, cough, headache, fatigue\"\n",
        "    ),\n",
        "    outputs=\"text\",\n",
        "    title=\"AI Disease Prediction App\",\n",
        "    description=\"Enter your symptoms and get a predicted disease 🤖 (Built entirely from my phone!)\",\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "iface.launch(share=False)"
